title: Udemy Business integration (LMS/LXP) | Xobin
text:
Why integrate Udemy Business with Xobin?
Assessments tell you where the gaps are. Learning platforms tell you how to close them. Most organisations run the two in isolation, so insight never turns into action and L&D spend is disconnected from measured need.
Integrating Udemy Business with Xobin joins the two ends of the cycle. Xobin assessments and skill gap analysis surface exactly which competencies are weak, at individual, team, and role level. Those gaps map to relevant Udemy courses and learning paths, which are recommended directly in the employee's development plan. Learning activity and completion then flow back into Xobin, so L&D, HR, and business leaders can see not just what was assigned, but whether capability actually moved.
The result is a closed loop: assess, recommend, learn, reassess.
How it works
Assess
Run any Xobin assessment: skill tests, psychometric assessments, 360 degree feedback, or a full development assessment centre. Xobin scores performance against your competency framework.
Identify the gap
Xobin's skill gap analysis compares each person's scores against the benchmark for their current role or target role, and highlights the specific competencies that need development.
Recommend learning
Each gap is matched to relevant Udemy Business courses and curated learning paths. Recommendations appear inside the employee's Individual Development Plan, so learning is tied to a measured need rather than a generic catalogue.
Track progress
Course enrolment, activity, and completion are visible in Xobin alongside assessment data. Managers and L&D teams track development against the plan from one dashboard.
Reassess and prove impact
Re-run the assessment after the learning period to measure movement in the competency, and report on the return from your learning investment.
What you can do with this integration
Map Udemy courses and learning paths to your own competency framework.
Auto-recommend learning based on Xobin assessment and 360 feedback results.
Attach recommended courses to Individual Development Plans and succession plans.
Track learning progress and completion inside Xobin, next to assessment scores.
Compare pre and post learning assessment scores to measure capability uplift.
Report on skill gaps and learning coverage by role, team, function, and location.
Prioritise learning spend against the gaps that carry the highest business risk.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is built for L&D leaders, HR business partners, and talent management teams who use Udemy Business for learning and want their programmes driven by measured skill data instead of assumption. It suits organisations running structured development programmes, succession planning, high potential identification, or reskilling initiatives, where the goal is not just to deliver courses but to demonstrate that capability improved.
It is equally useful in hiring. Where a strong candidate falls short on one or two competencies, Xobin can flag the gap and route a targeted learning path from day one of onboarding.
Integration availability
The Xobin and Udemy Business integration is available on request. Share your competency framework and Udemy Business plan details and our team will scope the mapping and rollout with you.
